description:
“It allows me to go faster with fewer dependencies and then do things that I couldn’t do before.”

Chris Jones, Senior Lead, Ops AI Lab at Shopify, is helping teams use ChatGPT Work to redesign workflows with agents, remove bottlenecks, and build tools without waiting on engineering resources.

“What would’ve been a large team supporting a process now comes down to an agent that can run discrete tasks.”

Check out how ChatGPT Work can work for you: http://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/
title: How Shopify Uses ChatGPT Work to Build Faster with AI Agents

author: OpenAI
description:
Racing is a sport of tiny margins and mountains of data. OpenAI researcher Joyce Ruffell and RaceTek Systems co-founder Chase Holden are each using AI to help teams make better use of information from the track, the garage, and the people behind the wheel. They discuss OpenAI’s research collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing and how Chase used ChatGPT and Codex to go from hosting a NASCAR podcast to building a racing intelligence company. They also examine how AI could give smaller teams an edge without replacing the human expertise at the heart of racing, and why car culture runs so deep at OpenAI.

Chapters

00:43 Intro to OpenAI researcher Joyce Ruffell and Chip Ganassi Racing
02:43 Intro to Chase Holden and RaceTek Systems
07:45 Joyce’s path into racing
10:00 Helping racing teams work with AI
15:31 Combining human feedback with racing data
18:26 How AI helps smaller teams compete
21:43 Spreadsheets and the “data wars” in racing
27:03 Getting started with AI and Codex
30:08 How Rac
title: What racing reveals about working with AI — the OpenAI Podcast Ep. 22

author: OpenAI
description: How should companies think about hiring in the age of AI? In this OpenAI France voxpop video, Peter Steinberger, Member of Technical Staff at OpenAI, shares why creativity, curiosity and the ability to work with AI agents are becoming increasingly valuable—and why organisations may need to rethink what great AI talent looks like.
title: The AI Era Needs a Different Kind of Talent | Peter Steinberger | OpenAI France

author: OpenAI
description: What are the most successful companies doing differently with AI? At OpenAI France, Emmanuel Marill, Managing Director, EMEA at OpenAI, shares why the biggest opportunities come from thinking AI-first rather than adding AI to existing ways of working. He also reflects on focus, solving real business problems and why France has one of the world's strongest AI ecosystems.
title: Think AI-First: Emmanuel Marill on Building AI-Native Companies | OpenAI France

author: OpenAI
description: The way we work with AI is changing. Katia Gil Guzman, Developer Experience at OpenAI, explains why we're moving from prompts to goals, how AI is enabling anyone to become a builder, and what excites her most about the rapidly evolving builder community in France. Filmed at OpenAI France.
title: Stop Prompting. Start Giving AI Goals. | Katia Gil Guzman | OpenAI France

author: OpenAI
description: AI is moving beyond experimentation. In this OpenAI France voxpop video, François Weider, Go-to-Market Leader for France & Southern Europe at OpenAI, explains why organisations are shifting from pilots to production, how to prioritise AI use cases that deliver measurable business value, and why executive role modelling is critical for successful AI adoption.
title: From AI Pilots to Production | François Weider on Enterprise Adoption | OpenAI France

author: OpenAI
description: What separates the most successful AI founders? Laura Modiano, Founder Experience at OpenAI, shares the lessons she sees across Europe's startup ecosystem—from testing and listening to customers to shipping quickly. Filmed at OpenAI France event, this voxpop video explores what it really means to build an AI-native company.
title: What Great AI Founders Do Differently | Laura Modiano | OpenAI France

author: OpenAI
description: If you've been sitting on an idea, now is the time to build it. In this OpenAI France voxpop video, Romain Huet, Developer Experience at OpenAI, talks about the incredible energy of France's developer community, why curiosity is every builder's superpower, and how tools like Codex are helping people turn ambitious ideas into reality.
title: Have a Crazy Idea? Build It with Codex | Romain Huet | OpenAI France
